issues.t: T6 automatic transmission failure
issues.sym: Slipping, flaring revs between gears, harsh or delayed shifts, a transmission warning, and eventually no drive at all.
issues.why: The 2.9L T6 used a GM-based 4-speed automatic that was not strong enough for the engine's torque. Failures were common enough to lead to a lawsuit.
issues.next: Have the fluid checked and the codes read at the first sign of slipping. On these cars a rebuilt or replacement transmission is usually the only lasting fix.

issues.t: AWD angle gear (transfer case) leaks or fails
issues.sym: Gear oil dripping near the front center of the car, a burning oil smell, a whine that changes with speed, or the rear wheels no longer being driven.
issues.why: The angle gear sends power to the rear axle on AWD models. Its seals leak, and once the oil level drops the gears wear out quickly.
issues.next: Have the angle gear checked for leaks at every oil change. Resealing early is far easier than replacing a failed unit.

issues.t: Worn front control arm bushings
issues.sym: A clunk over bumps, a vague or wandering feel at highway speed, shaking under braking, or uneven tire wear.
issues.why: The rubber bushings in the heavy XC90's front control arms wear and crack with age and mileage.
issues.next: Have the front suspension inspected. Control arms are usually replaced as complete units, followed by an alignment.

issues.t: Clogged crankcase breather causes whine and oil leaks
issues.sym: A high-pitched whine or whistle at low rpm, oil leaks from seals, or oil in the intake.
issues.why: The crankcase ventilation oil trap and hoses clog with sludge, building pressure inside the engine.
issues.next: Have the breather (oil trap) system checked. Replacing it is usually a quick job and prevents seal leaks.

issues.t: Tires wear out early
issues.sym: Tires wear unevenly on the edges and need replacing far sooner than expected.
issues.why: Owners of early XC90s report alignment and suspension geometry problems causing rapid tire wear.
issues.next: Get a four-wheel alignment and check for worn suspension parts before buying new tires.

issues.t: Outer tie rod ends can break (recall)
issues.sym: Loose or wandering steering, a clunk from the front, or loss of steering control if a tie rod breaks.
issues.why: The outer tie rod ball joint can deform and fracture.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. The dealer fits improved tie rods for free.

issues.t: Fuel pump flange can crack and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell around the rear of the car, especially in hot weather.
issues.why: The plastic flange on top of the fuel pump can crack in hot climates and leak fuel.
issues.next: Check your VIN. The recall covered cars in certain hot-weather states; have any fuel smell checked right away.

issues.t: Wipers can stick in winter (recall)
issues.sym: The wiper arms stop moving or stay in the parked position in heavy snow and ice.
issues.why: The wiper arms can slip on their shafts in extreme winter conditions.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the free repair done before winter.

issues.t: Rear seat belt anchors may not be fitted right (recall)
issues.sym: No obvious symptom; second or third row belts may not hold properly in a crash.
issues.why: Some belt attachments in the second and third rows were not installed correctly.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the belts inspected for free.

issues.t: Starter cable terminal can short and start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from the engine bay, or electrical faults.
issues.why: The battery terminal on the starter could touch the starter solenoid and short out.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the free inspection done.

issues.t: V8 engine mount bracket can break (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk when shifting or accelerating, or the engine moving excessively.
issues.why: Incorrect bolts were used on some V8 engine mount brackets, which could let the bracket break.
issues.next: Check your VIN; the dealer inspects and replaces the bracket and bolts.

issues.t: Power steering fluid leak causes sudden heavy steering (recall)
issues.sym: Power steering fluid under the car, a whining pump, or steering suddenly becoming very heavy.
issues.why: A power steering pipe connection can leak fluid.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the free pipe replacement done.

issues.t: Engine loses power while driving
issues.sym: The dash may go blank and the engine loses power or stalls in traffic.
issues.why: Owners of 2016 XC90s report sudden power loss; reported causes range from electrical faults to engine failure.
issues.next: Get to a safe spot and have it towed. Ask the dealer to check all software updates and open recalls.

issues.t: Automatic emergency braking activates by mistake
issues.sym: The car brakes hard or warns of a collision with nothing in the way.
issues.why: Owners report the City Safety automatic braking system acting on false alarms.
issues.next: Report each event to the dealer and NHTSA. Ask for sensor recalibration and software updates.

issues.t: Sunroof drains clog and leak water
issues.sym: Water dripping from the headliner, behind the mirror or onto the floor after rain.
issues.why: The sunroof drain tubes clog or the seals fail, so water spills into the cabin.
issues.next: Have the drains cleared and the sunroof seals checked. Dry the interior fast to protect electronics.

issues.t: Main or backup battery drains or fails early
issues.sym: Dead battery, battery warnings, or auto start-stop stops working.
issues.why: These XC90s use a main battery and a small auxiliary battery. Owners report early failures of both and drains fixed with software updates.
issues.next: Have both batteries tested and ask the dealer for the latest software.

issues.t: Center screen or navigation unit freezes or fails
issues.sym: The touchscreen freezes, reboots, goes black or shows navigation and antenna errors.
issues.why: Owners report head unit and control module failures and glitches, sometimes needing the unit replaced.
issues.next: Try a reset by holding the home button, then ask the dealer for software updates or a replacement under warranty.

issues.t: Brake vibration from warped rotors
issues.sym: Shaking through the wheel or pedal when braking, or squealing.
issues.why: Owners report front rotors warping and pads and rotors being replaced more than once at low mileage.
issues.next: Have the rotors measured; replace pads and rotors together.

issues.t: Air suspension compressor failure
issues.sym: A suspension warning, the car sitting low, or the compressor running loudly.
issues.why: Owners report air suspension compressor failures on these XC90s.
issues.next: Have the system checked for leaks before replacing the compressor, since leaks wear compressors out.

issues.t: Coolant hose can leak near the catalytic converter (recall)
issues.sym: Coolant smell, low coolant warning, or smoke from under the hood.
issues.why: A coolant bleeder hose can crack and drip coolant on the hot catalytic converter, a fire risk.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the hose replaced for free.

issues.t: A/C drain hose leaks water into the cabin (recall)
issues.sym: Wet front carpet, especially after using the A/C, and possible air bag warnings.
issues.why: The A/C condensation drain hose was installed wrong, so water collects inside and can damage air bag electronics.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the hose fixed for free.

issues.t: Front passenger seat belt buckle can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: The buckle may wobble or separate from its mount.
issues.why: The buckle mounting stud can loosen.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the free inspection.

issues.t: Side and curtain air bags may not work (recall)
issues.sym: The air bag warning light may come on; side protection may be reduced.
issues.why: Two recalls: misrouted wiring could disable the front side air bag, and the third-row curtain air bags may not fully inflate.
issues.next: Check your VIN for both recalls.

issues.t: Curtain air bag bolts and third-row belt parts can fail (recall)
issues.sym: No warning; in a crash the curtain air bag may not deploy right or a third-row belt part may come loose.
issues.why: Curtain air bag mounting bolts can break, and a third-row belt retractor gas generator can detach.
issues.next: Check your VIN for both recalls.

issues.t: Automatic emergency braking may not detect obstacles (recall)
issues.sym: No warning; City Safety may not brake for pedestrians, cyclists or vehicles.
issues.why: A mismatch between software and hardware in the driver assistance module.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the software update. Do not rely on automatic braking until it is done.

issues.t: Fuel pump fuse can blow and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls or will not start.
issues.why: The fuse for the low-pressure fuel pump can blow.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the free fuse replacement.

issues.t: Loose screw can lock the steering (recall)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly binds or locks.
issues.why: A screw can fall into the steering gear.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the steering gear replaced for free.

issues.t: Brake assist and ABS can lose function (recall)
issues.sym: Brake warning lights and a firmer pedal with less power assist.
issues.why: A badly welded rotor and shaft in the brake hydraulic unit can separate.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the hydraulic unit replaced for free.

issues.t: High-voltage battery can short and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: No warning; a fire risk when fully charged and parked.
issues.why: A high-voltage battery module can short circuit.
issues.next: Do not charge until repaired. Check your VIN and book the free repair.

issues.t: Engine computer error can stop the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine will not start, or drive power is lost while driving.
issues.why: A software error in the engine control module.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the free software update.

issues.t: Second-row seat belt bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Usually none; a buckle or child-seat anchor may feel loose.
issues.why: Second-row buckle and lower anchor bolts may not be tightened.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the bolts inspected for free.

issues.t: Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
issues.sym: No rearview image when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A software fault. A first fix was replaced by a second recall.
issues.next: Check your VIN; cars fixed under the first recall need the newer update.

issues.t: 12V battery critical charge warning or drain
issues.sym: A battery critical charge message, or the car will not start; plug-in hybrids may drain after charging.
issues.why: Volvo issued bulletins for 12V battery drains, including plug-in hybrids after charging and a Wi-Fi connection issue.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to apply the bulletin software and test the battery.

issues.t: Transmission performance reduced message
issues.sym: A message saying transmission performance is reduced, sometimes with odd shifts.
issues.why: Volvo issued bulletins fixing this message with new transmission software.
issues.next: Have the dealer install the latest transmission software.

issues.t: Center display stuck or unresponsive
issues.sym: The center touchscreen freezes, stays in recovery mode or ignores touches.
issues.why: Volvo issued bulletins for the center display getting stuck and touch functions not responding.
issues.next: Try a restart, then have the dealer apply the bulletin fix.
